steps.send: set -e -o pipefail; test "$(systemctl is-active gdm)" = active; test "$(awk '/^ [0-9]+ / {count++} END {print count}' /proc/asound/cards)" -eq 1; grep -q '^ 0 .*VirtIO SoundCard$' /proc/asound/cards; head -c 192000 /dev/zero | timeout 15 aplay -D hw:0,1 -t raw -c 2 -r 48000 -f S16_LE; timeout 15 arecord -D hw:0,1 -c 2 -r 48000 -f S16_LE -d 1 /tmp/dory-capture.wav; test "$(stat -c %s /tmp/dory-capture.wav)" -gt 192000; tools_block=$(basename /sys/devices/platform/c101a00.virtio_mmio/virtio*/block/vd*); test -b "/dev/$tools_block"; sudo dd if="/dev/$tools_block" of=/run/dory-agent bs=1 count=1402336 status=none; echo '74b952b176f2aea7c576bac815a9eb2e3c8f8a2625c14767500b8a45f6b5fd9c  /run/dory-agent' | sha256sum -c -; sudo chmod 0755 /run/dory-agent; sudo modprobe vhci_hcd; sudo sh -c 'nohup /run/dory-agent >/tmp/dory-agent.log 2>&1 &'; for attempt in $(seq 1 120); do test ! -e /dev/video0 || break; sleep 1; done; test -c /dev/video0; lsusb -d d0f1:ca01; timeout 20 ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -f video4linux2 -input_format mjpeg -video_size 1280x720 -i /dev/video0 -frames:v 1 -c:v copy /tmp/dory-camera.jpg; test "$(stat -c %s /tmp/dory-camera.jpg)" -gt 1024; file /tmp/dory-camera.jpg | grep -q 'JPEG image data'; test "$(identify -format '%wx%h' /tmp/dory-camera.jpg)" = 1280x720; printf 'DORY_CAMERA_%s\n' USB_READY
